oracle.sourceBranch: main (O-REPLAY 0.4.1 pinned at a9c1327 by contract 0.3.8+, V-O04c)

hand.source: TARGETS section 7 items 1 to 6; RULINGS Q24

afterErasurePublishes.bases: every basis, including bases before the erasure

hand.pinnedReader: a read that started before the erasure published may return the old value (compare with the pre-erasure O-REPLAY digest)
hand.rebuild: after rebuilding every index from the source of truth, PII values are still markers
hand.restore: after restoring a pre-erasure backup, the erasure ledger (erasure:<sid>) is replayed and PII values are markers again
hand.protectedCopies: every lane lists its protected-copy inventory (TARGETS 7 item 3) in the receipt; order keys of PII attributes are inside the envelope (item 4)
hand.reproduction: GS.12-style repeat answers compare with erased values replaced by their markers (item 2)

gaps: O-REPLAY has no erasure rule (ErasedValue markers): post-erasure expectations are hand-derived and need an oracle rule
Triplex has no erasure or crypto-shredding mechanism yet (R15); this scenario cannot run until a lane provides one
